blocks.p: The *Mods* window lists the mods you have. The tabs along the top of the list choose what it shows: *All*, *On*, *Problems*, *Conflicts* and *Workshop*, each with its count. The mod chosen in the list is shown in its info pane, at the right of the window.

caption: Figure 50-1
The Conflicts tab of a mod's info pane.

blocks.p: Two mods conflict when both hold the same file or define the same item. The info pane's *Conflicts* tab lists each conflict and says which mod's copy the game uses.

marks.text: Same file in two mods: the later mod's copy is the one used.
Choose file by file picks which mod's copy of a shared file runs.
Same item in both: the game reads by file name, so order changes nothing.

blocks.h2: The List and the Info Pane

blocks.p: A mod with a problem says so in its info pane, in a line under the pane's tabs, with a mark beside it.

caption: Figure 50-2
The list, part of an info pane, and two problems.

marks.text: Tabs for problems, conflicts and the Workshop.
A mod in conflict says so in its row.
Each mod says what turning it off would do.
A mod it needs that is not installed is marked.
A mod made for another game version says which.

sticky.text: What each mod needs and what turning it off does.
